name: Survey sensor
description: Particulate sample output and shared storage accounting.

outputs.name: Particulate samples
outputs.description: One PAYLOAD_MEASUREMENT report per sample, carrying its PM2.5 concentration as the private measurement kind named by com.example.survey.pm2-5, with measurementId as listed in this function's catalogue entry. The report carries only this value. Any other per-sample detail has no defined wire representation in this dialect, and a client that needs it relies on a vendor extension or a future dedicated message instead of guessing a structure for PAYLOAD_MEASUREMENT's single value field.

binding.correlation: measurement_id=1, per this function's measurements inventory

resources.name: Recording storage
resources.description: Onboard storage shared with the recording function, reported as STORAGE_INFORMATION.available_capacity in its native MiB. The concrete pool for this instance is resolved by this function's capabilityProfileRef.resourceScope, not by sharedResourceKey alone.

binding.correlation: storageId selector bound on the function's storage-information serviceBinding, matched to STORAGE_INFORMATION.storage_id and the packet source; the reported level is that message's available_capacity field, in MiB
